tub.description: A complete tub/process case with a fixed nonnegative tolerance.

admissible.description: Satisfies the Tub and Process premises in SPEC.md; arithmetic opaque to VE.

water.description: Water material premise holds; arithmetic opaque to VE.

air.description: Air endpoint premise holds; arithmetic opaque to VE.

metal.description: Positive submerged metal volume and greater density premises hold; arithmetic opaque to VE.

bounded.description: Nonnegative tolerance and air-mass bound hold; arithmetic opaque to VE.

stable.description: Final height is Within the fixed nonnegative tolerance; arithmetic opaque to VE.

lower.description: Final height is strictly below the rim; comparison opaque to relational VE.

dry.description: Cumulative spill is zero (not that the tub contains no water).
